change_summary: Distinguish source-container grouping from work-subject identity while retaining operational closure and semantic-leaf ownership.

canonical_skill.note: The Skill passes source-container, work-subject, closure and independent-duty evidence without prescribing Project names, leaf taxonomy, or artifact count.

server_contract.note: The server keeps source-container wording weaker than work-subject identity and carries Project-closure and semantic-leaf owner proofs while Runtime remains a non-semantic executor.

package_manifests.note: Skill and Plugin manifests advance together; compatibility family and minimum revision remain unchanged.

workspace_cli.note: Workspace and Admin CLI remain at 0.1.0-beta.35; their shared server-discovered processing-profile contract remains compatible and needs no CLI protocol change.

help_center.note: Public Help remains compatible because the public Skill page projects this shared package and the release does not change remote MCP connection or installation steps.

package_setup.note: SessionStart reports the new Skill release; the full Skill carries the closure and independent-owner handoff boundary.

harness_and_mainline.note: The Harness separates input-container cohesion from governed work identity, retains the operational-closure counterfactual, and defines the leaf as the smallest independently continued semantic owner.

external_marketplaces.note: First-party publication, public hashes and fresh released-host readback remain release gates; external directory acceptance stays outside repository authority.

release_evidence.note: Focused schema and prompt gates cover container-singular countercases, true same-work transfer, Project closure, leaf ownership and unchanged Runtime authority; fresh Codex and Claude effect/readback remain release gates.
